name: ConnecTendo
summary:
ConnecTendo is a free daily browser puzzle about Nintendo history. The board shows sixteen Nintendo games, and your job is to sort them into four hidden groups of four. A group can be a franchise, a platform, a genre or four consecutive release years, among others.

You have four tries, and after every miss you get a hint. Unlimited modes in normal and hard let you keep playing once today’s puzzle is solved, and a collection tracks every category you have found. A shared result lets you compare your run with other players.

Puzzles are built from a hand-curated database of more than 7,700 Nintendo and Nintendo-exclusive titles that also powers the other puzzles on the site.

ConnecTendo is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Nintendo.
